data.title: Ghost Broker Policy Pattern — Multiple Policies with Disposable Contacts and Below-Market Premiums
data.description: Detects ghost broker activity by identifying intermediaries submitting multiple insurance policies using disposable contact details (temporary email addresses, prepaid phone numbers) with premiums significantly below market rates. Ghost broking victims increased 93% in 2025, with organized operators selling fake or fraudulently obtained policies at 30-60% below market rates. The combination of high policy volume, rotating disposable contacts, and below-market pricing is the hallmark pattern of ghost broker operations. City of London Police made arrests in May 2025 and IFED designated February 2026 as a ghost broking intensification month.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_intermediary_volume AND filter_premium AND filter_disposable_contacts

enrichment_required.source: Market average premium by risk category from actuarial benchmarks
Count of policies with disposable email domains or prepaid phone numbers

queries.cql:
// CQL for Ghost Broker Policy Pattern Detection — DL-0188
// Identifies intermediaries with high policy volume, disposable contacts, below-market premiums
InsurancePolicies
| policy_type = "motor" OR policy_type = "vehicle"
| issue_date >= now() - 90d
| premium_pct_of_market := round(premium_amount / market_avg_premium * 100, 1)
| premium_pct_of_market < 70
| is_disposable := if(match(contact_email, "(protonmail|guerrillamail|tempmail|throwaway|yopmail)"), 1, 0)
| groupBy([intermediary_id, intermediary_name],
    function=[count() as policy_count,
              countDistinct(contact_email) as distinct_emails,
              countDistinct(contact_phone) as distinct_phones,
              avg(premium_amount) as avg_premium,
              sum(is_disposable) as disposable_email_count])
| policy_count >= 5
| distinct_emails > policy_count * 0.8 OR disposable_email_count >= 3
| sort(policy_count, order=desc)
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Ghost Broker Policy Pattern Detection
-- Multiple policies with same intermediary, disposable contacts, below-market premiums
SELECT
  p.intermediary_id,
  p.intermediary_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.policy_id) AS policy_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.contact_email) AS distinct_emails,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.contact_phone) AS distinct_phones,
  AVG(p.premium_amount) AS avg_premium,
  m.market_avg_premium,
  ROUND(AVG(p.premium_amount) / m.market_avg_premium * 100, 1) AS premium_pct_of_market,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.contact_email LIKE '%@protonmail%'
    OR p.contact_email LIKE '%@guerrillamail%'
    OR p.contact_email LIKE '%@tempmail%'
    OR p.contact_email LIKE '%@throwaway%'
    OR p.contact_email LIKE '%@yopmail%'
    THEN p.policy_id END) AS disposable_email_policies
FROM insurance_policies p
JOIN market_premium_benchmarks m ON p.risk_category = m.risk_category
WHERE p.issue_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND p.policy_type IN ('motor', 'vehicle')
  AND p.premium_amount < (m.market_avg_premium * 0.70)
GROUP BY p.intermediary_id, p.intermediary_name, m.market_avg_premium
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.policy_id) >= 5
  AND (COUNT(DISTINCT p.contact_email) > COUNT(DISTINCT p.policy_id) * 0.8
       OR disposable_email_policies >= 3)
ORDER BY policy_count DESC
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Ghost Broker Policy Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies intermediaries with high policy volume, disposable contacts, below-market premiums")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:policy_management
  (policy_type="motor" OR policy_type="vehicle")
| lookup market_premium_lookup risk_category OUTPUT market_avg_premium
| eval premium_pct_of_market = round(premium_amount / market_avg_premium * 100, 1)
| where premium_pct_of_market < 70
| eval is_disposable = if(match(contact_email, "(protonmail|guerrillamail|tempmail|throwaway|yopmail)"), 1, 0)
| stats count AS policy_count,
        dc(contact_email) AS distinct_emails,
        dc(contact_phone) AS distinct_phones,
        avg(premium_amount) AS avg_premium,
        sum(is_disposable) AS disposable_email_count,
        values(market_avg_premium) AS market_avg
  BY intermediary_id, intermediary_name
| where policy_count >= 5
  AND (distinct_emails > policy_count * 0.8 OR disposable_email_count >= 3)
| eval premium_discount = round((1 - avg_premium / market_avg) * 100, 1)
| sort - policy_count

references: Aviva, Ghost broking: the scale and impact of fake insurance (November 2025)
City of London Police / IFED, Ghost broking enforcement activity (May 2025)
ABI, Annual Fraud Report 2024 (2025) — UK fraud topped GBP 1B
Insurance Times, Ghost portals: the next evolution in insurance fraud (2025)
falsepositives: Legitimate high-volume intermediaries with diverse client bases
Intermediaries serving privacy-conscious customers who use privacy email services
Seasonal fluctuations in premium pricing (promotional periods)
